We assess the existing surface and junctions before specifying preparation and installation. Pool-interior work has its own quoted scope, separate from the external coping and terrace finish.

pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: Water loss alone does not establish a membrane fault. Describe the change in water level, when it occurs, the current lining and any previous repairs or reports. Plumbing, fittings and other causes may need separate investigation. Do not drain the pool or remove the lining for this enquiry; access and any preparation must first be agreed with the appropriate responsible parties. The written scope identifies the water-retaining surface, junctions, materials, checks and exclusions.
pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 失水不单独证明膜层故障。请描述水位变化、发生时间、当前内衬及既往维修或报告。管道、装置及其他原因可能需独立调查。不要为咨询排空泳池或拆内衬；通行及准备应先与适当负责方确认。书面范围列明蓄水表面、交接、材料、检查及排除项目。

pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: Describe the current lining, water loss pattern and any previous reports. Safe photos are optional; do not drain the pool for an enquiry.
pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 描述内衬、失水规律及既往报告。安全照片为选填，不要为咨询排空泳池。

pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: We agree access, surface preparation and separate plumbing investigation where needed.
pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 确认通行、基层准备及必要的独立管道调查。
泳池防水系统需适合长期浸水

pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: We check that the selected pool membrane is specified for permanent immersion and the actual pool base. Certain polymer-modified cementitious products suit immersed applications, but the category name alone is not approval. We coordinate the membrane with pipe penetrations, joints, tile adhesive, grout and the proposed water-treatment environment. Curing before tiling and curing before filling are separate stages in the selected system.
pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 我们核对所选泳池防水膜是否明确适用于长期浸水及实际池体基层。部分聚合物水泥基产品适合浸水环境，但类别名称不能代替产品适用说明。防水膜应与穿管、接缝、瓷砖胶、填缝料及拟采用的水处理环境配合。铺砖前和注水前的养护，是所选系统中的不同阶段。
